# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Read and follow the repository root `AGENTS.md` before making changes.

When the user says only `Go`, execute the `Go` protocol in `AGENTS.md`:
- recover and review an unfinished PR first;
- otherwise choose the next unblocked issue from `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PHASES.md`;
- keep all unfinished work resumable from GitHub-visible state;
- do not ask the user to select work when the repository already determines the next executable task.

See also `docs/AGENT_FACTORY.md`.
